items.name: vignette
items.title: Vignette
items.description: Decorative curved-monitor edge darkening (inset shadow and radial falloff) with an optional static scanline. aria-hidden, pointer-events none.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Place <Vignette /> as the last child of a relative container. Pass scanline for the static stripe pattern; it has no animation, so reduced motion needs no extra handling.
